body:
## Add temporary fragile blocks to your world with a simple command!

**/givefragile <player> <slot> <blockType> <seconds> <particle>**

This plugin allows you to give players blocks that break automatically after a set amount of time. Whether you're building minigames, challenges, or simply want decaying parkour platforms, Fragile Blocks adds a lightweight and flexible mechanic.

## 🔧 Features
Give players "fragile" blocks with a configurable lifetime.

Particle effects upon expiration.

Simple and intuitive command syntax.

Great for custom maps, traps, or timed challenges.

## 📜 Example

/givefragile hamatiii 1 minecraft:glass 5 exp
→ Gives hamatiii a glass block in slot 1 that shatters after 5 seconds with a explosion particle effect.

/givefragile hamatiii 1 minecraft:glass 5 none
→ Gives hamatiii a glass block in slot 1 that shatters after 5 seconds without a particle 

# 📦 Compatibility

Works with **Minecraft 1.20.6** only

**✅ Requires [ProtocolLib](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/protocollib.1997/) to function properly**

Lightweight and compatible with most servers

## 💡 Use Cases
Parkour courses with decaying platforms

Minigames with timed blocks

Adventure maps with trap mechanics
